name: Flori
source:
Interest: People, Dreaming & Rice

Flori is designed to be the polar opposite of [url=https://vndb.org/c56751]Llima[/url]. Despite her delicate appearance, she is the mentally stronger of the two. In a way, she is the crux of their relationship, and the one who holds their bond together.

[From in-game character profiles description]
